summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0, Levels 1–4 and M.E.G. Base Gamma, with local place simulations building spaces, supplies and actors around shared grid, loot, creature and NPC systems. Ordered player/NPC behavior chains connect movement, combat, interactions and HUD; Fallout-style skills, lockpicking and checkpointed level transitions extend the survival loop.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's generated yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded moments and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, searchable loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze zones/crawl halls, hazards, loot, creature brigades and Gamma checkpoint; breakable walls and powered lift lead to Level 4.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards and residents; sim adds the locked Database computer.

places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office, a 64×64 m floor with perimeter/corner offices, fountains, break-room vending, Level 3 lift, chained stairs and Base Omega; sim adds residents, cubicles, phones, printers, tasks and computers.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, actions, player template and HUD renderer; crouch is Z and almond-water splash is an action.
templates/player.js - ordered behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch, crouched eye height, computer view and the third-person death camera.
places/<place>/sim.js - local setup/tick roots; level sims lay arrival markers and maintain creature packs; Level 4 builds offices/residents and Gamma places its Database terminal.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; scene NPCs carry behavior/state and critter model attachments.

scripts/ui.js with loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js, craft-ui.js, os-ui.js, horde-ui.js, noclip-ui.js and lockpick-ui.js - HUD composition, transition card and action overlays; wardrobe/character creator is switched off in critter.js.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading behavior; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim and creatures.
scripts/lib/level4.js - office room/wall plan, zones, sanity rates and names read by Level 4 geometry, resident/office systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + scripts/lib/data/level4-people.yml - Level 4 resident homes, routines, meetups, greetings and phone errands; sim spawns their shared NPC agents.
scripts/lib/os.js + scripts/lib/data/os.yml - host profiles, mail/files/Database/forum/Recycle Bin/System Properties and terminal commands for os.js and os-ui.js.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/data/clothes.yml - garment definitions, fitting and leveled loot/NPC wardrobe rolls reused by loot systems, player clothing and place NPC spawners.

scripts/lib/data/almond.yml and breakables.yml - almond-water variants/effects and material/tool/drops tuning; critter-models.yml defines shared bodies/heads/faces; loot.js/items.js define loot tokens including bobby pins.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/gamma/sim.js also exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level4.js - HALF/H/room-plan constants, ROOMS/WALLS/COLUMNS, zoneAt, DRAIN4, L4_NAMES and roomAt.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js - roundsFor, speak, settle, tickPeople, PEOPLE4; scripts/l4-office.js - ears, phoneTask, update; scripts/computer.js - ears.
scripts/lib/os.js - PROFILE, mailsOf, filesOf, entriesOf, entryById, binOf, forumOf, passwordOf, runCmd; scripts/os.js - onInput, update; scripts/os-ui.js - osUi.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - fullLook, rollLevel, leveledRows, rollCloth, npcLook and clothing helpers; scripts/lib/breakables.js - wall/prop damage, sync and sweep helpers.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - shared critter model/look/morph helpers; scripts/lib/stats.js - attribute/skill helpers; scripts/lockpick.js - onInput, update, startPick; scripts/lockpick-ui.js - pickUi.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi; scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update; scripts/horde.js - update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/sanity, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass, crouch and colored almond-water counts/timers; player-local session holds walk, transition and respawn timing.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state hunger/thirst, craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; needs drain and starvation reduces hp but floors it at 1; crafts validate recipe/skill/materials.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries the owning player's horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.
scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu, notices and interaction; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state, containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state.

scripts/talk.js and scripts/critter.js - dialogue state is split across player/NPC; player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots and avatar scratch is local/session state; NPC appearance/build is saved in state.look/wear/build.

scripts/os.js and Level 4 systems - player.state.os/osNote/osClosedAt own active app, saved notes and close timing; computer entities own host/unlock; place.state owns homes/clock/errands and office scheduling. scripts/lockpick.js owns player.state.pick and pickP/pickR HUD values; attempt controls are session-local.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: humanoid-locomotion reads prior movement before player writes control; interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick and horde handle ordered actions before critter behavior.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and crouched eye height; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state; death state pulls the view to third person briefly.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 sim's powered lift door → level4#l4-lift-arrive; Gamma door returns to Level 3 fortress gate.

scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; level1/2/3 sims spawn the inbound markers, and scripts/player.js chooses the nearest safe spawn/door checkpoint after death.
scripts/player.js writes player.state.xfer on place change → scripts/ui.js draws the named level transition card; level-door.js and exit crossing flash to black before crossing.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js sends typed text/actions through talk/talkdo/shop inputs to talk.js; talk.js submits llm:chat and heard validates replies/checks before rapport changes.

talk.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle → talk-ui.js / ui.js; nearby NPC voice is emitted; shop actions update almond water, inventory and NPC stock; Level 3 Gamma agents use chatter data for nearby conversations.

interact.js E → door/container/bench or usable-specific press event; usable computers boot player-local Back OS directly, while Level 4 l4-home.js ears.press handles plates, cooler, fountains, vending and chained stairs.

E on lockpick-locked door/container → interact.js checks skillsOf then calls lockpick.js startPick; lockpick.js reads A/D/W/S axes and lock target, spends bobby pins on snaps, clears door/container lock on success; lockpick-ui.js renders player.state.pickP/pickR via ui.js.

E on usable computer → scripts/interact.js creates player.state.os from entity host/lock; scripts/os.js handles OS action keys and lock/password/Science/admin state via lib/os.js + os.yml; os-ui.js renders the app in scripts/ui.js.
Level 4 phone/printer/shift board → l4-office.js tasks and player.state.l4task; completion writes player.state.payout, which craft.js redeems as XP/items and craft-ui.js displays task progress.
scripts/lib/loot.js rolls bobby pins into containers/Level 1–2 loot; player.js pickup token increments player.state.bobbypins; lockpick.js consumes one on each snapped pin.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office base, non-colliding lived-in detail, varied abandoned props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + scripts/l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambient sounds, office tasks and supply rewards.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + data/level4-people.yml - Level 4 agents share home/round/meetup/phone/greeting logic, varied by faction, role, voice, look/build and routine.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml - leveled garment lists vary by player/place tier and rarity; faction wardrobe rolls vary by faction, level and stable NPC id across Level 1–4, Gamma and Omega spawners.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; uploaded Tripo rigged meshes and horde hunt hooks.

scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js and scripts/stealers.js + stealer-geo.js - shared level-specific hound grids/safe zones and skin-stealer disguise/reveal behavior vary by place and hunt phase; Level 1–3 sims restore missing pack managers.
scripts/lockpick.js + lockpick-ui.js + scripts/lib/loot.js - skill-gated Fallout-style picking is reused by locked doors and containers; lock level/skill changes sweet-spot width and pin durability.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4's plan is 64×64 m with 8 m-wide, 6 m-deep offices. Keep geometry/zones/exits aligned to each grid.

Level 4 base l4-geo is the structural mesh/collider; l4-detail-geo draws ceiling, carpet and wall wear without a collider; l4-prop-geo and l4-office-geo supply repeated placed detail. Scene entries or sim-spawned bodies provide collision.
Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js, craft.js, os.js, lockpick.js, horde.js and critter.js; NPC arrays likewise put locomotion before meg-agent.js.

Door transition IDs are coupled: level-door.js PAIR targets sim-spawned inbound markers; player.js CHECKS references the same marker IDs, plus place default spawns, for nearest checkpoint respawn. Keep arrival rotations and checkpoint positions aligned with door geometry.

Lock contracts: entity.state.lock is 'lockpick:<level>' or 'science:<level>'; lockpick attempts need player.state.bobbypins. A/D sweep pin angle in degrees, W turns the cylinder and S exits; snapped pins are consumed, while successful picking clears lock and opens the door/container.
